turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Of course! Let me show you one first.
"I cook pasta." Now the subject is "he".
Step 1: "he" is one person.
Step 2: so I add -s to the verb: "He cooks pasta."
The rule: after he, she or it, the verb ends in -s.
Right: She works on weekends. Wrong: She work on weekends.

Now it's your turn. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
